sentences: Stan and Ben are the best at sprints.
passage:
Brent and Clint must get Mum a gift. 
The kids went to Pam’s Plant Stand. 
The gift Brent and Clint get is a plant pot.

Brent helps Clint cut ten red dots. 
Next, Clint helps Brent stick six red spots on the pot.
The kids set the plant pot in a big gift box.

The plant pot Brent and Clint got is grand.
“Yes!” said Mum, “This is the best gift. 
You are the best kids.”
